title: Chapter 1343 - 21: Caution

Chapter 1343 - 21: Caution

Chapter 1343: Chapter 21: Caution

Forming a prison with pure Spiritual Power is a technique only used by Entering Dao Masters.

"That young man, is he an Entering Dao Master?"

A few men in golden robes looked terrified.

How many Entering Dao Masters are there in the entire world?

Apart from those cultivated by the Da Feng dynasty, other states, the most prosperous ones may have one or two, or two or three Entering Dao Masters.

More than half of the states don’t even have an Entering Dao Master.

On average, across the ninety-nine states, excluding Central State, the other eighty-eight states together have only about forty or fifty Entering Dao Masters.

Forty or fifty Entering Dao Masters? Although that number seems considerable, it’s the accumulation of the whole world.

Ninety-eight states, each with a population exceeding ten billion people, on average, one Entering Dao Master emerges from twenty billion people.

Plus, Entering Dao Masters can generally live past one hundred and twenty years, whereas normal people usually live to fifty or sixty, which is considered a good life; the true probability of an Entering Dao Master being born must be even smaller.

An Entering Dao Master, as long as they are willing, can completely dominate several states as a king, as long as they don’t oppose the court; the court is happy to appease them.

"A hundred-yard range of the Heaven and Earth Prison..." Compared to the terror of the men in golden robes, the leading senior was even more frightened inwardly.

He held a high position in the Golden Dragon Sect, following the Heavenly Master within the sect, knowing that even as strong as the Heavenly Master, when deploying the Heaven and Earth Prison, it could only reach within twenty to thirty yards.

The Spiritual Power of an Entering Dao Master is not infinite.

But the Heaven and Earth Prison formed by Lin Yuan exceeds a hundred yards?

What kind of majestic Spiritual Power is needed to sustain it?

How could such a powerful Entering Dao Master have never been heard of before?

...

Having dealt with four disciples of the Golden Dragon Sect, Lin Yuan glanced at his third uncle and said, "Third Uncle, you go back first, leave Man State to me."

"Okay, okay."

Third Uncle responded hastily.

For twenty years, it was his first time witnessing his family’s young master truly make a move.

Although he had long known the young master was strong, an Entering Dao Master?

Even at its most prosperous period, the Red Lotus Sect only had a few Entering Dao practitioners.

As for an Entering Dao Master?

They dare not even imagine.

If the Red Lotus Sect had an Entering Dao Master at the time.

They wouldn’t have had to roam several neighboring states.

Although the Red Lotus Sect established several sub-sects.

But those sub-sects were basically street rats.

Couldn’t appear openly.

If there was an Entering Dao Master.

The Red Lotus Sect could completely dominate a state for slow development.

...

Golden Dragon Sect back mountain.

Entering Dao Master ’Jin Yi’ sat cross-legged.

His physical body is weakening, although his Spiritual Power is strong, it comes from the physical body.

Once the physical body dies of old age, no matter how strong the Spiritual Power is, it will quickly vanish.

"Golden Dragon Sect has yet to produce a new Heavenly Master."

Jin Yi opened his eyes, worry appearing on his face.

Golden Dragon Sect, entrenched in Man State, has a vast potential influence, paired with an excellent relationship with the Da Feng dynasty.

Even though there is no Entering Dao Master stationed temporarily, it doesn’t cause too much trouble.

Not every state among the ninety-eight has an Entering Dao Master in residence.

But it is ultimately a hidden danger.

Without an Entering Dao Master, such as the Sea-Calming Divine Needle.

They ultimately lack confidence.

"Hopefully, before I sit in meditation, I can cultivate a new Heavenly Master."

"Even if not, at least a seedling of a Heavenly Master must appear."

Jin Yi thought quietly to himself.

Decades ago, the Golden Dragon Sect started concentrating resources, fully cultivating some disciple.

But an Entering Dao Master isn’t something you can definitely cultivate just with resources.

Just then—

Jin Yi’s expression changed, "Who is there."

"It’s me."

Before Jin Yi could react.

A young man stood nearby with a smile, looking over.

"You are....."

Jin Yi’s pupils contracted sharply, then he felt his own Spiritual Power was suppressed and sealed.

The young man walked easily to him, looking down at him.

"Who are you, Heavenly Master?"

Jin Yi had a hopeless expression.

From the brief contact just now.

Jin Yi was sure of one thing.

That he absolutely couldn’t be a match for the young man.

The opponent silently appeared nearby.

And sealed his Spiritual Power without any warning.

No matter which point, it highlights that the opponent wanting to kill him.

Is not a difficult task.

Jin Yi, although about to sit in meditation.

His physical body decayed and rotted.

But the fight between Entering Dao Masters.

Depends not on the physical body.

But on Spiritual Power.

In this respect, Jin Yi, the Entering Dao Master, is defeated completely.

"You don’t need to know who I am."

Lin Yuan smiled as he overlooked Jin Yi, "Now you have two choices."

"Two choices?"

Jin Yi’s heart trembled.

"One, give up resisting, let me perform the Soul Search, and then assist me in taking over the Golden Dragon Sect."

"I will ensure the Golden Dragon Sect’s inheritance remains unbroken."

Lin Yuan said.

After twenty years of cultivation.

Lin Yuan’s power now surpasses that of ordinary Entering Dao Masters.

An old-school Heavenly Master like Jin Yi stands no chance against him.

But in essence, Lin Yuan is also an Entering Dao Master.

He is of the same level as Jin Yi.

The most is his application of Spiritual Power far exceeds that of the opponent.

But performing a Soul Search? If it means completely receiving all memories of the other party.

Cooperation is still needed.

At least not violently resist.

"Soul Search?"

Jin Yi’s mouth twitched.

Entering Dao Masters study Spiritual Power.

They are capable of performing Soul Searches.

But performing a Soul Search on an Entering Dao Master?

An Entering Dao Master would never willingly have their soul searched.

All hidden secrets would be intricately exposed to the enemy.

"What is the second choice?"

Jin Yi’s voice was hoarse.

"I forcibly perform a Soul Search, the Golden Dragon Sect is utterly destroyed, and the inheritance is permanently severed."

Lin Yuan said directly.

Forcibly performing a Soul Search can result in memory loss and other consequences.

"Two choices."

"You choose one."

Lin Yuan gazed down at Jin Yi.

"I....."

Jin Yi fell into silence.

He had no doubt about the second possibility Lin Yuan mentioned.

With the power Lin Yuan has currently displayed.

Destroying the Golden Dragon Sect would be all too simple.

"I choose the first one."

Jin Yi sighed inwardly.

Though he was unsure if Lin Yuan would keep his promise.

He had no other choice now.

In any case, he was surely going to die.

Even if soul searched, it would at most mean a more painful end.

"So, the Golden Dragon Sect can continue its inheritance."

Lin Yuan nodded.

In fact, he had already foreseen Jin Yi’s final decision by observing the future timeline.

"Golden Dragon Sect?"

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Completely receiving Jin Yi’s memories, along with the assistance of this Entering Dao Master.

He could most securely absorb all influence and power of the Golden Dragon Sect.

As for forcibly purging, then inserting his own people?

That would be a most inferior approach.

Firstly, it’s likely to show flaws.

Secondly, it’s too wasteful.

The disciples of the Golden Dragon Sect exceed tens of thousands, with over two thousand Entering Dao practitioners.

To purge such a batch of high-quality subordinates?

...

Da Feng Dynasty, capital, within the imperial palace.

The young emperor sat upright on the throne, frowning in contemplation.

"For twenty years, I’ve also successfully become an Entering Dao Master."

The young emperor murmured to himself, "The greatest power of this dynasty is held in my hands."

"Within this capital, there are more than ten thousand Entering Dao spellcasters, over a hundred Entering Dao Masters, and several hundred thousand of the most elite Imperial Guards."

"With such colossal strength, if I wish, I could easily overtake the external ninety-eight states."

"Moreover, this palace is entirely crafted from special materials that restrain Spiritual Power, even an Entering Dao Master falls inside, they would be greatly suppressed, retaining but a fraction of their power."

"Thus, inside the palace, the patrols are from the most elite Imperial Guard, an Entering Dao Master daring to infiltrate could be easily torn apart by dozens of Guards, and there are hundred thousand Guards inside the palace."

The young emperor grew increasingly solemn in his thoughts: "Under such conditions, the demand of this calamity is merely for me to survive for a hundred and fifty years?"

"No, it should be a hundred and thirty years now."

"Just asking me to stay alive?"

The young emperor harbored no contempt, realizing that such a requirement implied the calamity he faced was certainly not something his current strength could easily counter."

If he could effortlessly prevail without any action.

Then it wouldn’t be worthy of being regarded as the final trial he must confront."

"Enough."

The young emperor surveyed his surroundings, which he deemed the safest place beneath the heavens—the imperial palace."

He had already made up his mind."

"I can’t stay in the palace any longer."
